Heartland Association of Fairs Festivals & Events Showcase

profile.description: Heartland Association of Fairs, Festivals & Events industry convention/showcase opportunity. Adventure Zone has prior HAFFE convention history. The 2026 convention is Nov. 19-21 in Minot, ND.

notes.subject: Time-sensitive 2026 showcase invitation
notes.body: HAFFE emailed Adventure Zone June 27, 2026 inviting applications to showcase at its November convention, with a Sept. 1 deadline. Current official HAFFE information confirms the Nov. 19-21, 2026 Minot convention includes showcases and associate/vendor activity. This is an active industry opportunity, not a stale unread message.

followUps.label: Decide HAFFE showcase application
followUps.reason: Review eligibility, cost, footprint and logistics now; submit before Sept. 1 if the showcase makes business sense.
